description: Experimental. Daily retro from your agents' own logs: reads today's Claude Code and Codex sessions on this machine, groups them by project, adds git state (commits, uncommitted files, unpushed commits) and lists the tails — what was done and what was left open. Then closes the tails the way the manager skill does: issue comment, commit or a conscious "drop". Runs by itself every evening as an automation. Triggers on "/daily-retro", "дневное ретро", "что сегодня сделали агенты", "подбей хвосты", "daily retro".
